notes: The full paved circuit follows the main straight, northern hairpin, upper switchback and southern wooded technical section visible in the independent 2019 aerial image. Pit-entry and paddock driveways are excluded. The operator identifies one full circuit with 18 turns; its advertised 2.2-mile length is approximate and is not used to scale the geometry. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3141.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 66 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
